book_title: Prologue: The Business, The Price & Our Independent Verdict

epigraph.quote: Never confuse a recovering stock chart with an unconditional compounder—and never confuse holding a small Stage 2 winner with a license to chase fresh capital without margin of safety.
epigraph.author: Independent Underwriting Desk

summary: Cyient Limited has pivoted from an asset-light ER&D vendor into a leveraged three-engine platform spanning Digital, Engineering & Technology (DET), Cyient DLM, and Cyient Semiconductors. While Q2 FY27 delivered +25% YoY revenue growth and a 10-quarter-high 14.2% DET EBIT margin, ₹2,328 Cr of new debt for Kinetic Technologies and TAO Digital requires integration proof. New capital is WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (₹1,027.29–₹1,058.57); existing 91 Zerodha shares are HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP at ₹951.20.

web_blocks.html: What Cyient Does: Founded in 1991 in Hyderabad, Cyient Limited (NSE: CYIENT) is an Indian engineering R&D, electronics manufacturing, and custom semiconductor group [1]. It operates three distinct engines. Cyient DET generated ₹1,664 Cr in Q2 FY27 across aero, rail, connectivity, and sustainability engineering, now augmented by TAO Digital [3][6]. Cyient DLM (₹393.1 Cr) is its 52.2%-owned listed aerospace and defense EMS subsidiary [13]. Cyient Semiconductors (₹184.7 Cr, +240.8% YoY) builds custom ASICs and Kinetic Technologies power-management ICs [7].

Independent Business & Financial Reality: Under CEO Sukamal Banerjee (appointed February 2025), DET stabilized and lifted EBIT margins to a 10-quarter high of 14.2% in Q2 FY27 [3][10]. Clean receivables (66 debtor days) and FY26 cash generation (₹787 Cr CFO, ₹693 Cr FCF, 118% CFO/EBITDA) confirm core cash discipline [1]. However, between March and September 2026, management ran a ₹720 Cr buyback while adding ₹2,328 Cr of new debt [1][9]. Borrowings jumped 6.4x to ₹2,759 Cr to fund Kinetic Technologies (~$85M) and TAO Digital (~$218M) [1][6][7]. That compressed ROCE to 12.3% and stretched DLM-led Cash Conversion Cycle to 119 days, earning a CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL business quality verdict [1].

web_blocks.takeaway: We respect the Stage 2 turnaround and hold existing shares with a hard ₹951.20 stop, while refusing to commit fresh capital at ₹1,104.90 until price reaches support or deleveraging is proven.

web_blocks.html: What Changes Our Mind: Three milestones would upgrade Cyient toward active accumulation. First, Q3 FY27 borrowings must step down below ₹2,500 Cr as interest expense stabilizes. Second, DET must hold 14.0%+ EBIT margins for two straight quarters while TAO Digital integrates smoothly. Third, Cyient DLM must trim its 303-day inventory so consolidated Cash Conversion Cycle falls under 90 days. Conversely, a close below ₹951.20 or DET EBIT slipping under 12.5% triggers an exit.

book_paragraphs: Welcome to our independent, ground-up underwriting of Cyient Limited. If you remember Cyient from its quiet decades as Infotech Enterprises—a debt-free Hyderabad engineering shop drafting maps for European utilities and stress-testing jet engines for Pratt & Whitney—the company you are looking at in November 2026 is a very different animal.

Over the past six months, Cyient has transformed itself into a leveraged, three-engine technology group. First, its core Digital, Engineering & Technology (DET) business is recovering under new CEO Sukamal Banerjee, posting ₹1,664 crore of Q2 FY27 revenue and a 10-quarter-high 14.2% EBIT margin. Second, its 52.2%-owned subsidiary Cyient DLM is scaling aerospace and defense electronics manufacturing with a 1.6x+ book-to-bill ratio. Third, Cyient Semiconductors surged 240.8% year-over-year after acquiring Kinetic Technologies for ~$85 million and raising $30 million from Edelweiss at a $500 million equity valuation. Alongside those moves, Cyient closed a ~$218 million acquisition of TAO Digital Solutions and completed a ₹720 crore share buyback.

That ambition came at a real balance-sheet cost. Consolidated borrowings jumped more than sixfold from ₹431 crore in March 2026 to ₹2,759 crore in September 2026, Fixed Assets and intangibles nearly doubled to ₹6,021 crore, ROCE compressed to 12.3%, and trailing ROE sits at 8.61%. That is why our price-blind audit assigns Cyient a CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL quality rating rather than an unconditional compounder badge.

At the 13 November 2026 close of ₹1,104.90, Cyient trades in a confirmed Week 12 Stage 2 uptrend, but its 4-hour chart is still consolidating below its 20-period EMA and its reward-to-risk ratio to our ₹1,280 Base Case target is only 1.14-to-1. For fresh money, our verdict is WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT inside the ₹1,027.29–₹1,058.57 zone (2.06-to-1 R:R). For your existing 91 shares in Zerodha (₹1,00,545.90, or 2.34% of your portfolio), our action is HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP at ₹951.20. Let us walk through every chapter of the evidence together.

book_callouts.text: Chapters 1 through 6 were written completely blind to Cyient's stock price so that market momentum could never bias our view of the business. Chapters 7 through 9 then test that business reality against Reverse DCF, five listed peers, and the live Stage 2 tape.

book_subsections.title: Your 3-Horizon Roadmap & What Must Happen Next
paragraphs: Before we dive into Chapter 1, keep this three-horizon compass in front of you as we walk through the evidence. Over the Short Term (1 to 3 months), Cyient is a Stage 2 uptrend digesting a 26% three-month rally; because its 4-hour chart has not yet turned up above ₹1,114.25, fresh capital waits for the ₹1,027.29–₹1,058.57 support zone (2.06:1 R:R) rather than chasing ₹1,104.90 (1.14:1 R:R). Over the Medium Term (6 to 18 months), everything hinges on Q3 and Q4 FY27 execution: we want to see DET hold 14%+ EBIT margins, TAO Digital and Kinetic Technologies integrate without margin dilution, and consolidated borrowings begin stepping down from ₹2,759 crore.

Over the Long Term (3 to 5 years), Cyient has assembled a rare combination of aerospace and rail ER&D, high-reliability defense electronics manufacturing, and custom ASIC silicon. If Sukamal Banerjee converts that three-engine footprint into a 16–18%+ ROCE and shrinks the Cash Conversion Cycle back below 80 days, Cyient can re-earn CORE_ALPHA compounder status. Until then, we hold your existing 91 Zerodha shares (2.34% portfolio weight) with a hard ₹951.20 stop and keep 100% of marginal cash in reserve.

One final word on how this monograph is organized so you can navigate it effortlessly. Chapters 1 through 3 trace Cyient's 35-year evolution from Infotech Enterprises to its three-engine 2026 structure, walk through real-world customer programs in DET, DLM, and Semiconductors, and break down every ₹100 of FY26 revenue into cash flow. Chapters 4 through 6 audit competitive moats, management's guidance track record, and 10 years of balance-sheet and working-capital forensics. Chapters 7 through 9 then open the 13 November 2026 market tape to test Reverse DCF assumptions, peer multiples, Stage 2 multi-timeframe shelves, and our exact Bull-versus-Bear action plan. Notice that every single number in both the Web Research Desk edition and this narrative companion comes from the exact same audited and verified snapshot.

Keep in mind that Cyient is not listed in the NSE Futures and Options segment, so there are no exchange-traded puts or call spreads to cushion volatility. Position sizing, patience at entry, and strict adherence to our ₹951.20 structural stop-loss are your sole risk-management tools. With that framing in place, let us turn to Chapter 1 and trace how a 1991 Hyderabad GIS drafting pioneer evolved into today's leveraged deep-tech platform.
